References[1][2][3][4]

Vivo X Fold is an Android-based foldable smartphone developed and manufactured by Vivo. This phone announced on 11 April 2022.[5][6] On 11 April 2022 was announced Vivo X Fold+ which is improved version of X Fold with more powerful GPU, bigger battery, faster charging and new red color.
